who.viewer: (from PERSON (where (= id @viewer)) (columns source vc_legal_name name_long_override name_long name_short_override name_short name_sort_override name_sort name_show slug grade classroom crew department job_title phone pronouns pronunciation facts facts_updated photo_updated))
who.people: (from PERSON (where (in id (members (slug "everyone"))) (not hidden)) (order name_sort asc) (columns source vc_legal_name name_long_override name_long name_short_override name_short name_sort_override name_sort name_show slug grade classroom crew department job_title phone pronouns pronunciation facts facts_updated photo_updated))
who.pictures: (from PHOTO (where ready (or (not (blank person)) (in group (select GROUP.id (in kind "family" "classroom" "grade"))))) (order order asc) (columns person group order ready thumbnail image crop_left crop_top crop_width crop_height))
who.groups: (from GROUP @g (where (!= status "closed") (or (in kind "family" "classroom" "grade" "gradeband" "crew" "department") (and (= kind "group") (= parent.kind "gradeband")))) (order order asc name asc) (columns parent kind slug name description color pronunciation order address phone))
who.members: (from MEMBER (where (= member "yes") (in group (select GROUP.id (= kind "family")))) (columns group person))
who.effective: (from EFFECTIVE_MEMBER (where (in group (select GROUP.id (or (in slug "students" "parents" "staff") (and (= kind "group") (= parent.kind "gradeband")))))) (include group) (columns group person))
who.tags: (from GROUP @g (where (own_group @g) (not (blank managed_by)) (!= status "closed") (not (exists GROUP (= managed_by @g) (!= id @g))) (manages @g)) (include managed_by) (columns name managed_by))
who.tagManagers: (from MEMBER (where (= member "yes") (in group (select GROUP.managed_by @g (own_group @g) (not (blank managed_by)) (!= status "closed") (not (exists GROUP (= managed_by @g) (!= id @g))) (manages @g)))) (columns group person))
who.managed: (from GROUP @g (where (or (blank start) (and (not (blank end)) (>= end today)) (and (blank end) (>= start today))) (manages @g) (sidebar_group @g)) (order name asc) (include parent parent.parent parent.parent.parent))
who.joined: (from GROUP @g (where (or (blank start) (and (not (blank end)) (>= end today)) (and (blank end) (>= start today))) (or (in id (select EFFECTIVE_MEMBER.group (= person @viewer))) (in rsvp_yes (select EFFECTIVE_MEMBER.group (= person @viewer)))) (or (!= kind "event") (not (blank rsvp_yes))) (not (manages @g)) (sidebar_group @g)) (order name asc) (include parent parent.parent parent.parent.parent))
who.tagMembers: (from MEMBER (where (= member "yes") (in group "grp00000000041")) (include person) (columns group person))
